# Resilient_Community_Feedback_Loop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop system where real-time tsunami risk predictions from neuromorphic sensors feed directly into community mitigation actions, which in turn update the prediction model's parameters. Enables adaptive, self-correcting coastal resilience infrastructure, a key use case for in-network learning and continuous model refinement.
